slides.title: Best day, counted twice?
slides.vo: What if your best day counted twice? That's the Booster Card.
Koshiqa is about building a habit of movement. One you can sustain, with no pressure.
But everyone's routine is different. Some members are active all week, moving around at work. Others are stuck at a desk on weekdays, and find their weekends for a morning run or a workout.
So members asked us: can we make the best use of our best days? Can my weekend cover for my weekdays?

slides.title: The Booster Card
slides.vo: So we built the Booster Card. You can apply it on any past day. Pick your best one.

slides.title: Doubles counted steps
slides.vo: The contest counts up to 15,000 steps a day. Booster doubles those counted steps.

slides.title: Adds 15,000 steps
slides.vo: Did 18,000 steps? 15,000 count, and Booster adds another 15,000.
But it only covers what you're behind. If your deficit is 10,000 steps, Booster adds 10,000 steps.

slides.title: Save it till it counts
slides.vo: No deficit, or a very small one? Save your Booster for when it counts. Any day with 15,000 steps or more gives you the full boost.

slides.title: Days ahead? Capping
slides.vo: And it's for past days only. For days ahead, there's Capping.
Some days you hit it out of the park, while others are normal.

slides.title: Best use of best days
slides.vo: Make the best use of your best days with booster cards.
